dashboard.summary: Open the deployed qym dashboard from the CLI.
dashboard.when_to_use: Use this when you want a fast handoff from CLI execution to the platform UI.
pitfalls: Set --no-open in headless sessions or remote shells.
If QYM_PLATFORM_URL is unset, the command falls back to http://localhost:8000.

submit.summary: Upload a saved results artifact to the platform.
submit.when_to_use: Use this when a run completed offline or from another machine and you need to ingest the resulting CSV or JSON.
pitfalls: The file format must be one of the saved qym result formats.

run.summary: Create, inspect, and compare evaluation runs.
run.when_to_use: This is the main noun for day-to-day evaluation execution and run inspection.

run create.summary: Execute a new evaluation run from a Python task function and a dataset.
run create.when_to_use: Use this for both ad hoc evaluations and repeatable local or CI runs.
pitfalls: Exactly one of --dataset or --dataset-csv must be provided.
LLM judge metrics require QYM_JUDGE_MODEL and QYM_JUDGE_API_KEY.
examples: qym run create --task-file examples/example.py --task-function my_task --dataset my-set --metrics exact_match,fuzzy_match
qym run create --task-file examples/rag_eval.py --task-function rag_task --dataset-csv data.csv --metrics relevance,faithfulness_llm --model gpt-4o-mini

run tasks.summary: List discovered tasks known to the platform.
run tasks.when_to_use: Use this to inspect what tasks are available when working from existing stored runs.

run list.summary: List stored runs with structured filters.
run list.when_to_use: Use this in automation or shell pipelines to find runs before comparing or analyzing them.

run get.summary: Fetch a single run by ID.
run get.when_to_use: Use this when another workflow already knows the run ID and you need the resolved payload.

run failed.summary: Inspect the failed items for a run.
run failed.when_to_use: Use this as the first stop when triaging regressions or broken datasets.

run compare.when_to_use: Use this for quick regression analysis between models, prompts, or datasets.

metric.when_to_use: Use this when selecting built-in metrics before a new evaluation.

metric list.when_to_use: Use this when you need an authoritative list for scripts or docs.

analyze.summary: Run AI-assisted analysis over completed runs.
analyze.when_to_use: Use this after a run completes and you want root cause or summary help.

analyze run.summary: Generate item-level root-cause analysis for a run.
analyze run.when_to_use: Use this when a run shows failures and you want structured explanations.

analyze summary.summary: Generate a summarized analysis for a run.
analyze summary.when_to_use: Use this when you need a compact narrative for stakeholders or release notes.

config.summary: Inspect or validate local platform configuration.
config.when_to_use: Use this before running evaluations in a new environment.

config show.summary: Show the resolved platform and Langfuse configuration.
config show.when_to_use: Use this to verify what the CLI will actually use after environment resolution.

config check.summary: Validate connectivity to the platform API.
config check.when_to_use: Use this when onboarding a machine, CI runner, or air-gapped environment.

workflows.title: Local evaluation workflow
workflows.summary: Author a task, point qym at a dataset, run locally, then inspect the resulting artifacts and platform view.
paragraphs: This is the default workflow for evaluating a single task or prompt against a known dataset.
Start with a small dataset and a small metric set so task failures are obvious before you scale up.
steps: Implement or choose a task function.
Decide whether the dataset lives in Langfuse or a local CSV file.
Pick metrics and, when needed, configure LLM judge credentials.
Run qym from the CLI and save results locally.
Open the dashboard to review failures, comparisons, and traces.

workflows.title: Platform deployment workflow
workflows.summary: Deploy qym-platform with Postgres, configure auth and encryption, then expose the dashboard and docs inside the target network.
paragraphs: The platform image is the shared system of record for runs, corrections, and analysis.
In air-gapped environments, build the image outside the target network if needed, then move the image artifact into the isolated environment.
steps: Set QYM_BASE_URL and QYM_ROOT_PATH to match the exposed route.
Choose QYM_AUTH_MODE and provide the required auth secrets.
Set QYM_LLM_CONFIG_ENCRYPTION_KEY before enabling stored user LLM credentials.
